official: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
audience: As a candidate for this exam, you should have subject matter expertise with data loading patterns, data architectures, and orchestration processes. Your responsibilities for this role include:
Securing and managing an analytics solution.
Monitoring and optimizing an analytics solution.
You work closely with analytics engineers, architects, analysts, and administrators to design and deploy data engineering solutions for analytics.
You should be skilled at manipulating and transforming data by using Structured Query Language (SQL), PySpark, and Kusto Query Language (KQL).

domains.name: Implement and manage an analytics solution

sections.title: Configure security and governance
skills: Implement row-level, column-level, object-level, and file-level access controls

sections.title: Orchestrate processes
skills: Choose between a pipeline and a notebook
Design and implement schedules and event-based triggers
Implement orchestration patterns with notebooks and pipelines, including parameters and dynamic expressions

sections.title: Design and implement loading patterns
skills: Design and implement full and incremental data loads
Prepare data for loading into a dimensional model
Design and implement a loading pattern for streaming data

sections.title: Ingest and transform batch data
skills: Choose between dataflows, notebooks, and T-SQL for data transformation
Create and manage shortcuts to data
Transform data by using PySpark, SQL, and KQL
Handle duplicate, missing, and late-arriving data

sections.title: Ingest and transform streaming data
skills: Process data by using Spark structured streaming

domains.name: Monitor and optimize an analytics solution
